overview: Dedicated polish pass for Find Us on memories.songara.uk/moment — no new mechanics, no letter. Corrected responsive letterboxed stage so constellation proportions and circular glows no longer stretch with viewport aspect. Rebuilt Leo and Sagittarius from J2000-projected data (ν Leonis labeled with Greek ν; removed Nu/Regulus/Chertan→Zosma; added Denebola↔Zosma; graph-drawn edges only). Replaced blob silhouettes with colorkeyed atlas reference art that persists after completion. Dual colour language (Leo warm gold / Sag cool silver). Rewrote sky→paper transition as one continuous beat: pause, lines dissolve, stars→gold flecks, drift/settle, paper emerges from darkness, sky fades, paper rotates/corner/fold, stop. Validated with typecheck, eslint, docker rebuild, and screenshot iterations under docs/artifacts/moments/find-us/polish-2/.
executiveSummary: Find Us polish is live: astronomically grounded graphs, exact star-centred lines, atlas art that stays, distinct Leo/Sag palettes, letterboxed stage, and a continuous constellation→paper reveal — still stopping before the letter.
